content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks nigeria

Selling ebooks in Nigeria without PayPal or Stripe means overcoming the infrastructure constraints imposed by these payment giants. The solution lies not in finding a workaround or a temporary fix, but in building a sovereign digital commerce stack that operates independently of these platforms. This approach ensures that digital creators maintain full ownership and control over their online stores, payment processing, and customer data. By building a sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can break free from the limitations imposed by Stripe and PayPal and take charge of their digital commerce operations.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A sovereign digital commerce stack is built using a combination of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly. The infrastructure consists of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments is used for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. This architecture provides a robust and scalable solution for digital creators to sell their ebooks and other digital products without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in countries where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy are unavailable or severely restricted. This includes creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, the Philippines, and other regions. By providing a sovereign digital commerce stack, COREMERCH empowers these creators to take control of their digital commerce operations and build a sustainable business model that is not dependent on external payment platforms.
A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you full ownership and control over your online store, payment processing, and customer data.

The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and other product options are also available for creators who want to build their own custom solution. Each product option is carefully designed to meet the unique needs of digital creators in restricted countries.

By following these steps, digital creators can take control of their digital commerce operations and build a sustainable business model that is not dependent on external payment platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
NOWPayments provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements.
